# Prospects (English-speaking) · Quick Gantt Planner

Segments et organisations à démarcher pour la fiche anglaise. Aucune donnée personnelle collectée : on
cible des fonctions et des structures, via LinkedIn ou des adresses professionnelles publiques. Les
organismes cités existent ; leur intérêt, leurs conditions et leurs contacts sont **à vérifier** au premier
contact. Calendriers intégrés : Angleterre et pays de Galles, États-Unis (fédéral), France ; l'Écosse,
l'Irlande du Nord, le Canada ou l'Australie n'ont pas leurs fériés intégrés (périodes à saisir à la main) :
ne pas les cibler en priorité.

## Priorité 1 · Acheteurs directs

| Segment | Pourquoi il a le problème | Où le trouver | Qui contacter | Message d'approche (3 lignes) | Canal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small builders and renovation firms (UK, 2 to 20 staff) | Several jobs in parallel, trades depending on each other, bank holidays moving everything; plans kept in spreadsheets | LinkedIn ("site manager", "director"), trade directories (Federation of Master Builders member search) | Owner, site manager | Is your job programme still in a spreadsheet? One line per task here, dependencies and bank holidays calculated, critical path in red. Free demo: link. | LinkedIn |
| General contractors and remodelers (US, small firms) | Same problem, federal holidays and many subcontractors | LinkedIn ("project manager", "remodeling"), local NARI chapters | Owner, project manager | A Gantt chart you type one line per task, with federal holidays skipped and an A3 print for your clients. | LinkedIn |
| Project managers in small and mid-sized companies | Projects of a few dozen tasks, no licence for heavy project software | LinkedIn ("project manager", "PMO", "operations manager") | Project manager, operations director | Critical path, float and progress tracking with nothing to install and no subscription. | LinkedIn |
| Event and trade show organisers (freelance or small agencies) | Fixed date, many suppliers, tasks to chain backwards from the event | LinkedIn ("event manager", "event producer") | Event manager | An event plan with milestones and a target window for each supplier, printable for the client. | LinkedIn |

## Priorité 2 · Prescripteurs

| Segment | Pourquoi | Où | Qui | Message | Canal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Project management trainers and course creators | Need a simple tool to show dependencies and the critical path to beginners | LinkedIn, online course platforms | Trainer | A free demo to illustrate the critical path in class; affiliate commission on sales. | LinkedIn, affiliation Gumroad |
| Home renovation bloggers and YouTubers (UK and US) | Their audience plans works without any tool | YouTube, blogs | Creator | A ready-made renovation plan (kitchen, bathroom) your viewers can adapt. | E-mail professionnel public, affiliation Gumroad |

## À vérifier avant de démarcher

- Conditions de démarchage B2B au Royaume-Uni (PECR) et aux États-Unis (CAN-SPAM) pour tout e-mail.
- Ton et vocabulaire avec un lecteur anglophone avant la première campagne.
